body: The use-case would be sending the user to an Algolia Instant search page with predefined filtering and faceting. This can be done for search parameters `q=searchterm`. And I'm pretty sure we can do the same with all sorts of filtering can't we? `fR[category][0]=value` and `dFR[facet]=value`. So having that detailed might be useful, I know I would have found it useful.
